description: This file defines a Java class 'StatusServices' that provides several static methods for querying status items and status change details within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with the entity engine, utilizes utility classes for validation and logging, and handles service requests related to status management.

classes.name: StatusServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for retrieving status list items and valid status change details within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status items based on provided status type IDs, handling validation and queries to the database.

methods.name: getStatusValidChangeToDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details about valid status transitions for a given status ID.
